subject: Vendr onboarding: profile governance & evidence ownership
messages:
From: Ethan Lewis <security@brightroot.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Dec 2024 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr profile onboarding + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Ben,

We're starting the security onboarding for BrightRoot in Vendr and flagged Redwood's profile as missing an explicit owner and a couple of SIG answers that BrightRoot requires for their procurement timeline. Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the profile steward (contact and email) and whether you can supply the latest SIG spreadsheet? BrightRoot Legal has a tight review window (they asked for vendor responses by 12/20).

Two quick asks:
- Assign an internal owner for the Vendr profile and confirm contact for follow-ups
- Upload SIG/CAIQ answers or tell us if you prefer us to pull via Vendr API and then we provide the portal link to reviewers

I've attached a templated SIG (we filled our columns) — call it SIG-questionnaire-v2.xlsx — for reference.

Thanks,
Ethan Lewis
Security Operations
BrightRoot

Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Lewis <security@brightroot.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 15 Dec 2024 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendr profile onboarding + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Ethan — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Naomi (security lead) and Jonas (platform) to confirm ownership and evidence handback cadence. Kimberly is our portal steward for Vendr uploads — she'll own the upload and manifest.

Naomi / Jonas / Kimberly: BrightRoot needs SIG/CAIQ answers by 12/20. Ethan attached their template and would prefer a vendor-uploaded bundle in Vendr. Can we commit to a clean upload + short evidence manifest by EOD 12/18? If there are gaps we should call them out in the manifest and add expected delivery dates.

I'll be the procurement contact on the thread for any contract-level clarifications but not the profile owner.

Ben Carter
Head of Trust & Safety (procurement escalation)
Redwood Inference

--- Original attachment: SIG-questionnaire-v2.xlsx ---

From: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Lewis <security@brightroot.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Dec 2024 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile onboarding + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Thanks Ben. Ethan — we can own the profile stewardship and upload to Vendr. Plan and ask below: 

1) Owner assignment
- Profile owner: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com (security contact)
- Portal steward (upload + manifest): kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com

2) Deliverables and timeline
- 12/16 EOD: upload initial SIG responses to Vendr and attach an evidence-manifest.csv that flags any items requiring legal review
- 12/18 EOD: provide supplemental evidence (screenshots, policy PDFs, SOC 2 attest) for the manifest items marked "pending"

3) Scope clarifications
- We'll answer the SIG with our current deployment posture (hosted API + dedicated capacity) and mark environment-specific items where appropriate. If BrightRoot needs CAIQ-formatted output, we can export a CAIQ mapping from the SIG sheet on request.

4) Attachments and portal link
- I'll attach the manifest to this thread when upload is done; Kimberly will post the Vendr profile link.

Notes for Kimberly / Jonas: please prioritize the SOC 2 evidence (attestation and auditor's report) and the KMS rotation docs — BrightRoot flagged encryption proof as important. If Legal needs to redline any evidence release, ping me first.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence-manifest.csv (will be uploaded with Vendr profile)

From: Ethan Lewis <security@brightroot.com>

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear plan. We'll watch for the Vendr link and the CSV manifest. A couple of reviewers will need read-only access to the profile; can Kimberly add the following reviewer emails as on-view in Vendr?
- procurement-review@brightroot.com
- external-audit@brightroot.com

If anything gets delayed please let me know ASAP so we can adjust the legal review window.

Best,
